examples.arabic: اشترت ليلى كيلوغرامين من البندورة الحمراء، وربطتين من البقدونس الطازج، وطلبت من البائع أن يزن لها خمس حبات من التفاح الأصفر.
examples.english: Layla bought two kilograms of red tomatoes, two bunches of fresh parsley, and asked the vendor to weigh her five yellow apples.
examples.transliteration: Ishtarat Layla kilogramein min al-bandoura al-hamra', wa rabtatayn min al-ba'dounis al-tazaj, wa talabat min al-ba'i' an yazin laha khams habbat min al-tuffah al-asfar.

examples.arabic: اقتربنا من بياع شاطر كان عم يبيع بندورة وخيار مستويين بأعداد كبيرة، والناس حوليه عم يسألوا عن الأسعار.
examples.english: We approached a clever vendor who was selling ripe tomatoes and cucumbers in large quantities, with people around him asking about prices.
examples.transliteration: Iqtarabna min bayya' shater kan 'am yibee' banadura w khiyar mustawwayn b-a'daad kbeereh, w in-naas hawleih 'am yis'alu 'an il-as'aar.
examples.storyTitle: A Delightful Shopping Day in the Old Souk

examples.arabic: بشتري بندورة وخيار طازة من البائع اللي بعرفه من زمان
examples.english: I buy fresh tomatoes and cucumbers from the seller I've known for a long time.
examples.transliteration: Bashtarī banadūra w khiyār ṭāza min el-bā'e' elli ba'rafo min zamān.
examples.storyTitle: A Morning Trip to the Market

examples.arabic: مبارح شفت خضار كتير غريبة حتى البندورة كانت عم تضحك علي
examples.english: Yesterday I saw very strange vegetables, even the tomatoes were laughing at me.
examples.transliteration: Mbarah sheft khudaar kteer ghareebe, hatta l-banadoora kanet 'am tedhak 'alayy.

examples.arabic: قلت له مرحباً بدي بندورة لو سمحت
examples.english: I said to him, 'Hello, I want tomatoes please.'
examples.transliteration: Olt-lo marhaba biddi banadura law samaht.
examples.storyTitle: A Trip to the Local Market

examples.arabic: اشتريت بندورة وخيار طازج عشان نعمل سلطة
examples.english: I bought fresh tomatoes and cucumbers to make a salad.
examples.transliteration: Ishtareet bandoura w khiyar tazej ashan ne'mel salata.
